nodes.summary: An abelian group $T$ is in the Mazur class when it is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ for some $n \in \{1, 2, \ldots, 10, 12\}$, or to $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/2m\mathbb{Z}$ for some $m \in \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.
nodes.title: The Mazur class of abelian groups

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$. The torsion subgroup of the group $E(\mathbb{Q})$ of rational points of $E$ is finite and has at most $16$ elements.
nodes.title: Mazur's torsion theorem

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$, given by a Weierstrass equation. The torsion subgroup of the group $E(\mathbb{Q})$ of rational points of $E$ is in the Mazur class: it is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ for some $n \in \{1, 2, \ldots, 10, 12\}$, or to $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/2m\mathbb{Z}$ for some $m \in \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.
nodes.title: Mazur's torsion theorem

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
